Ask AI
for a clock
at 3:00.
beats.say: Ask an AI to make a clock showing three o'clock.
You'll probably get ten past ten. Again.

beats.sub: the classic pose in watch marketing
beats.say: That's because almost every watch ad online is set to ten ten.

beats.sub: they never cover the brand name
beats.say: At ten ten, the hands frame the logo instead of covering it.
And a 2017 study found the pose reminds people of a smile.

beats.sub: its training photos are full of it
beats.say: So the AI learned from a sea of photos stuck at ten ten, and now it barely knows any other time.

beats.sub: tell me what time you got
beats.say: Try it yourself, and tell me in the comments what time you got.
Follow for more things the algorithm did.
